0022600106.text: The Philadelphia 76ers, 2-0 and first in the Atlantic and the East, host the Milwaukee Bucks, who are 0-1, 13th in the East, and one game back in fourth place in the Central. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dean Wade (ankle, sprain), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Milwaukee has no listed absences. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
